title: utterance
description: The bare two-fold [token, claim] — the input to articulate. Token is the identity-carrying side; claim is the content-carrying side. Both are non-assembling primitives that do not decompose further.

prefixItems.description: Token: the identity-carrying side. Non-assembling; does not decompose.
Claim: the content-carrying side. Non-assembling; does not decompose.
